info.title: TeR27 Vehicle Dynamics & Telemetry API
info.description: Real-time 60 Hz Godot MirenaSim UDP bridge, CasADi simulation runner, Pacejka MF 6.2 tire evaluator, and Validation Vault API for Tecnun e-Racing TeR27 4WD.

vehicle_model.title: Vehicle Model
vehicle_model.description: Optional vehicle model switch (full_14dof, fast_3dof, differentiable_casadi_14dof)

suspension_mode.title: Suspension Mode
suspension_mode.description: Optional orthogonal suspension mode (analytic_1d_lut, 3d_double_wishbone_lut, decoupled_heave_roll, standard_pushrod)

udp_connected.title: Udp Connected
udp_connected.description: True when live Godot UDP frames are being received

godot_cmd_port.title: Godot Cmd Port
godot_cmd_port.description: UDP port sending commands to MirenaSim

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Solver fidelity and driver envelope mode

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Return cached validated CasADi reference metrics without spawning IPOPT

y.title: Y
y.description: Evaluated force or moment (N or Nm)

log_path.title: Log Path
log_path.description: Path to CAN/CSV/ASC/BLF/Parquet telemetry log file (relative to repo root or absolute).

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Inline telemetry trace dictionary (vx_ms, ax_ms2, ay_ms2, wz_rads, steer_deg, throttle, brake).
